finding: All six production screenshots were explicitly inspected with view_image. Desktop and medium preserve the two-column card hierarchy, typography, margins and action buttons; portrait preserves readable single-column cards and controls. Gesture screenshots show 23 percent, Studio and Press 1 / Release 1; live-reflow screenshots preserve 36 percent, Balanced and the selected Morning / Calm preset. No error overlay or unintended clipping observed. Partly visible virtual rows at viewport boundaries are intentionally clipped.
limits: Windows installed-font rendering and browser mouse input only; no claim of hardware touch testing, packaged glyph coverage or native appearance.
